definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to form a word naming a category of physical objects or substances. Common in formal, technical, and legal vocabulary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧{物|ぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一種|いっしゅ}→一種：01628_isshu⟧だ。
examples.english: A building is a type of structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧{物|ぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機内|きない}→機内：18819_kinai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}んで→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not bring dangerous items on board.

examples.japanese: ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧{物|ぶつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{廃棄|はいき}{物|ぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please separate hazardous items from other waste when putting out your trash.

notes:
Suffix forming nouns that name categories of physical objects or substances. Reads ぶつ. Distinct from the same kanji read もの (an everyday word for 'thing') and from the reading もつ in expressions like ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{建造|けんぞう}{物|ぶつ}→建造物：24301_kenzoubutsu⟧: a building; constructed object
- ⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧{物|ぶつ}: a structure (engineering)
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧{物|ぶつ}: dangerous item
- ⟦{化合|かごう}{物|ぶつ}→化合物：25020_kagoubutsu⟧: chemical compound
- ⟦{農産|のうさん}{物|ぶつ}→農産物：14360_nousanbutsu⟧: agricultural produce
- ⟦{廃棄|はいき}{物|ぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧: waste

PRONUNCIATION:
- ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: thing (everyday vocabulary; stand-alone noun)
- 〜{物|ぶつ}: object; substance (technical/formal compounds)
- 〜{物|もつ}: belongings (⟦{荷|に}{物|もつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ luggage, ⟦{手|て}{荷|に}{物|もつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧ hand baggage)
